purpose: Show current Tesla Energy power flow, battery charge, system status, solar charging advice and selected-window history.
primaryGoal: Understand solar production, home consumption, battery/grid direction and charge, with trustworthy current and historical evidence.

dataSources.behavior: Key ['tesla-live-status', siteId]; truthy-site enablement; INTERVALS.STANDARD polling; AbortSignal forwarded. Page derives live DataState and accepts a snapshot only when the response has id.
dataSources.sourceTrust: Independent stale warning; retained data remains visible on refresh failure; no-record envelope is unavailable.
dataSources.units: Consumer treats power as W, energy as Wh, SOC as percent; backend SI correctness is UNVERIFIED.

dataSources.behavior: Key includes site, both bounds and limit; STALE_TIMES.STANDARD; safeArray selection; AbortSignal forwarded. Page maps timestamps to epoch milliseconds and preserves null solar/battery/grid/load/SOC samples.
dataSources.sourceTrust: Historical DataState and separate stale warning; fatal and retained refresh errors remain distinct.
dataSources.unknowns: Server date parsing, bound inclusivity, ordering, limit truncation and full-window completeness were not inspected.

dataSources.behavior: Independent site-keyed STANDARD polling query with cancellation. Strip renders server verdict, W-to-kW surplus and recommended amps, but consumes only data and disappears for absent/no_data responses.
dataSources.sourceTrust: Not registered in page dataSources; loading, failure, stale/offline and retry are not represented by this strip. Type includes snapshot_age_s and explanation; no freshness policy is inferred.

dataSources.behavior: Header and three empty-card actions invoke the mutation; pending indicator on header. Success invalidates live/history keys; existing mutation toast handles success/failure. Advice key is not invalidated.

Requested power-flow.range persistence key and 7d default; consumes calendar start/end instead of precise instant bounds. /power-flow is range-enabled and vehicle-disabled in workspaceScope.ts:55,124. No local range or vehicle picker.
Existing preference subscription supplies SOC precision. fmtWatts delegates to numberFormat.ts:91 locale/precision formatting after a finite-number guard; W/kW scaling is display-only.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Three cards repeat live loading/fatal/empty/content branches at 294,328,352, but have distinct titles, skeleton heights and meaningful empty messages.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consider existing source-state composition during implementation only if all per-card geometry, context and recovery survive; no speculative universal wrapper.

sourceStrategy: Status and advice wrap at page:235 and SolarChargeAdviceStrip.tsx:39; refresh uses wrapLabel at page:210.
Live overview stacks then uses md:grid-cols-2 and xl:grid-cols-3 at page:290.
History stacks until 2xl:grid-cols-3 at page:405; power gets two columns at page:408.
Both charts use min-w-0 wrappers and 100%-width ResponsiveContainer, with heights 320 and 260.

issues.detail: Non-wrapping flow row contains two translated labels, icon and formatted magnitude; overflow with long translations or large readings is a source risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Exercise narrow allocated widths, RTL, long labels and 200% text; permit reflow without losing direction or value.

sourceStrengths: Localized system-status/live-overview/history aria-labels; decorative action/status/KPI/flow icons hidden from assistive technology.
Chart ariaLabel and explicit evidence dataColumns at each ChartCard call site.
Solar advice supplies role=status and a localized name when rendered.

issues.detail: Flow direction is conveyed by aria-hidden ArrowDown/ArrowUp; line 75 strips sign from readable magnitude. Negative battery/grid flow still exposes the fixed source/destination labels with a positive magnitude, losing charging/export direction in accessible text.
issues.fix: Provide localized accessible direction text or sign-aware readable endpoints; preserve visual magnitude-only convention, known-zero behavior and null placeholder.

issues.detail: Bare ChartTooltip receives numeric epoch time and no explicit units. ChartTooltip.tsx:67-80 stringifies non-ISO numeric labels and :83-104 adds only supplied units. SOC repeats this wiring at BatterySocChart.tsx:85.
issues.fix: Use existing labelFormatter/valueFormatter for localized date-time plus signed W/kW or SOC percent, preserving unknowns and raw exports; no shared tooltip replacement.

accessibility.status: Runtime keyboard, focus, screen-reader output, contrast, forced colors, targets and reduced motion UNVERIFIED.

states.live: No-retained-data loading drives strip/card skeletons. Fatal errors drive each card's QueryError/refetchLive. No-id responses produce three titled empty states with Tesla refresh. KPIs retain refresh-error data but suppress fatal values. Independent stale warning is present.
states.history: Initial loading goes to both ChartCards; fatal error gives titled QueryError/refetchHistory; empty array gives empty=true. Historical DataState warning preserves retained payload on refresh failure.
states.unknown: Power, SOC and energy remain nullable; missing grid status is neutral Unknown. Storm/backup site details distinguish null from false. Zero power has no directional KPI label. Grid-services row remains conditional on nonzero value.
states.mutation: Header binds isPending; hook supplies success/error toast and live/history invalidation. Actual disabled, auth/demo and failure behavior was not exercised.
states.offline: Existing DataState/PageLayout composition is present; exact offline rendering and source-age behavior UNVERIFIED.

issues.detail: Only data is consumed; absent/no_data returns null at line 36. Independent pending, unavailable, failure, retry and retained/stale states disappear, and page:131-142 registers only live/history. A different live endpoint cannot establish advice-source trust.
issues.fix: Retain an advice slot and compose existing DataState/source-review/recovery mechanisms for this query; preserve verdict, surplus and amp guidance while keeping successful neighbors visible.

visualIssues.detail: Inactive chip uses fixed-white border/background; active line 61 chooses a local cyan surface. This is source-confirmed theme-specific decoration, not proof of literal pure-white text or measured contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Use canonical neutral surface/border and restrained semantic accent tokens, reducing saturation/noise while retaining active/inactive and unknown/zero distinctions.

visualIssues.detail: Five fixed saturated hex assignments bypass existing chart palette ownership. No neon/glow class was found on the page; actual composed chart intensity is UNVERIFIED.
visualIssues.fix: Map domain series to restrained existing palette/semantic tokens without dropping solar/battery/grid/home/SOC identities or resetting explicit user chart preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: History consumes calendar start/end at line 113, not shared startInstant/endInstantExclusive documented at useRangeState.ts:117-122 and returned at :678-683. Precise rolling/timezone/exclusive-upper-bound information is lost at this call boundary; server behavior is unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass precise workspace bounds through the typed hook after confirming server support for both bounds; do not substitute filtering of only the loaded 1000 records.

architectureIssues.detail: SOC ticks/table interpolate raw value plus percent instead of shared locale/precision formatting, unlike live gauge and power formatting.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse current number-formatting preference subscription at display boundary; preserve finite/null guards, 0-100 domain and raw percentage exports.

priority.rationale: Source trust and preserved range/direction semantics precede cosmetic adoption. No implementation or runtime acceptance is claimed.

competingImplementations.detail: Local FLOW_COLORS coexists with canonical CHART_COLORS already consumed by SOC and exported by chartUtils.tsx:5 and charts/index.ts:42-43.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse canonical palette exports for domain assignments; do not add another palette engine. This is the same finding as the palette visual issue, not a second required component.

preservation.sectionCountingMethod: Eight user-facing units; four literal section openings, three page LayoutCard openings, two dependency ChartCard openings. Direct GlassPanel/ChartContainer openings both zero; extracted ChartCard framing remains.

dataBehavior: DEFAULT_SITE_ID=1 and no implemented site picker; preserve until separately authorized real site integration.

Preserve site-keyed queries, AbortSignal forwarding, polling/stale policy, both history bounds and limit=1000; server completeness remains unknown.
No-id snapshot envelope unavailable; null/undefined/non-finite inputs are unknown, never fabricated zero.
Battery positive means discharging, negative charging; grid positive importing, negative exporting. Grid unknown neutral; known non-Active maps danger. Backend status vocabulary unverified.

Retained refresh-error data and independent live/history warnings survive; fatal error cannot erase successful neighbors.
Refresh uses existing toast and invalidates live/history; independent advice polling remains.
SI wire/cache values remain unchanged; fmtWatts display-only W/kW and Energy Wh rendering are preserved. No new legacy converter.
Preserve localization, precision/locale, motion preferences, all source/actions/sections and export evidence; shared internals and export completeness not accepted by source inspection.
